fast.why: Today is Thursday: deeds are presented to Allah, and the Prophet ﷺ liked to be fasting when his deeds were presented. Next: Monday 30 Nov.

blessing: Your safety: you woke up today unharmed, with a roof over your head. Say 'Alhamdulillah' for it and make a short dua for protection for your family.

verse.text: Say, 'Nothing will befall us except what Allah has decreed for us; He is our Protector.' And upon Allah let the believers rely.

hadith.text: The Prophet ﷺ said: "If you relied upon Allah as He should be relied upon, He would provide for you as He provides for the birds: they go out hungry in the morning and return full."

lesson.title: Seerah: tawakkul in the Cave of Thawr
lesson.text: On the Hijrah, the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr hid in the Cave of Thawr while the Quraysh searched. Abu Bakr feared; the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us' (Quran 9:40; also Bukhari 3653). He took every means (a guide, a hiding place, a plan) and then relied on Allah. That is tawakkul: effort, then trust.

name.text: "Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative" (35:30). Allah multiplies even your small efforts at work and worship; nothing done for Him is wasted.
"Allah is the Wali of those who believe" (2:257). Sleep tonight knowing He looks after you.

world.text: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists set it at 85 seconds to midnight on 27 Jan 2026, the closest ever, citing nuclear risk, AI and great-power rivalry.
Forecasters' chance of a 'World War Three' before 2050 (10M+ deaths, major powers involved).
Prof Jiang's latest lectures on geopolitics and where great-power conflict is heading.

Nuclear deterrence makes all-out war a losing move for every major power, so the stable outcome (flashing) is 'compete, don't fight': trade wars, arms races and proxy conflicts. The real danger is a misread in a crisis like Taiwan or Ukraine, which is why the clock and the forecast are rising. Meter: 2 of 5.
